No, you don't need to send the wrong plant back. A wrong live plant is yours to keep at no charge, and we'll ship you the correct item free by Express (where your delivery zone allows).

I'm sorry about the mix-up. To get the correct plant on its way, please report it from "My Orders". The policy doesn't state a deadline for wrong-item reports, but the 48-hour window applies to damaged items, so reporting soon is best. Would you like me to escalate this to a Support Lead if you run into any trouble?
